description: Scrape restaurant data from Zomato for major Indian and UAE cities. Provide direct URLs or use the city + cuisine/category/rating filter builder.

category.description: Category ID filter (e.g. 2=Fine Dining, 6=Cafes, 11=Pubs and Bars).
category.title: Category

city.description: Pick a supported city to build a search URL from filters below. Supported: major Indian cities + UAE.
city.sectionDescription: Alternative to URL mode. Pick a city and (optionally) filters below.
city.title: City

cuisine.description: Cuisine ID filter (e.g. 55=Italian, 25=Chinese, 50=North Indian). See README for full list.
cuisine.title: Cuisine

enrich_details.description: Fetch the detail page for each restaurant (menu highlights, hours, contact, features). Disable for speed.
enrich_details.title: Fetch Full Details

expand_cuisines.description: When set, fan out across 15 top cuisines for the chosen city — 9 × 15 ≈ 135 restaurants per city.
expand_cuisines.title: Expand Cuisines

expand_localities.description: When set, also scrape each locality page Zomato exposes for the chosen city.
expand_localities.title: Expand Localities

ignore_url_failures.description: Continue the run if some URLs fail after retries.
ignore_url_failures.title: Ignore URL Failures

max_items_per_url.description: Up to 9 (Zomato server-side cap). Pagination beyond 9 is not available.
max_items_per_url.title: Max Items Per URL

min_rating.description: Filter to restaurants at or above this rating.
min_rating.title: Minimum Rating

start_urls.description:
Zomato restaurant/search/locality URLs. Examples:
- https://www.zomato.com/mumbai/restaurants
- https://www.zomato.com/ncr/restaurants/biryani
- https://www.zomato.com/mumbai/bandra-west-restaurants
- https://www.zomato.com/dubai/delivery

Each URL returns up to 9 restaurants (Zomato server-side cap).
start_urls.sectionDescription: Enter one or more Zomato URLs. Each URL returns up to 9 restaurants with full details.
start_urls.title: Zomato URLs

title: Zomato Scraper
